content.value_statement: Writing reliable Opentrons protocols requires accurate deck, labware, pipette, and module choices. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code draft structured Protocol API v2 workflows.
actual_capabilities: Drafts Opentrons Protocol API v2 protocol structure with metadata, requirements, and run functions.
Maps Flex and OT-2 deck layouts with labware, tip racks, pipettes, and adapters.
Builds liquid handling steps for transfer, distribute, consolidate, mix, air gaps, and blow out.
Shows module control for temperature, magnetic, heater-shaker, thermocycler, and plate reader workflows.
Provides template patterns for basic transfers, serial dilution, plate replication, and PCR setup.
limitations: Generated protocols still require simulation before use on physical robots.
It does not verify calibration, firmware, deck clearance, or real lab safety constraints.
API names and version details should be checked against the installed Opentrons App.
It does not connect to robots or execute protocols directly.

use_cases.title: Create a New Liquid Handling Protocol
use_cases.description: Turn a manual transfer plan into a Protocol API v2 draft with labware, pipettes, and deck slots.

use_cases.title: Adapt a Template for an Assay
use_cases.description: Modify serial dilution, plate replication, or PCR setup patterns for different volumes and sample counts.

use_cases.title: Review Robot Setup Details
use_cases.description: Check whether a planned workflow includes required tip racks, module calls, liquid labels, and simulation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Protocol
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Opentrons Protocol API v2 draft for a Flex robot that transfers 50 microliters from A1 to B1. Include metadata, requirements, labware, tip rack, pipette, and comments.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Serial Dilution
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a serial dilution protocol for one 96-well plate row. Use a Flex p300 single-channel pipette, add diluent to columns 2 through 12, then perform 1:2 dilution steps.

prompt_templates.title: Add Module Control
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Protocol API v2 workflow that loads a thermocycler, opens the lid, distributes master mix, adds eight samples, closes the lid, and runs a PCR cycling profile.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Full Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Opentrons protocol plan for tip usage, deck layout, module steps, liquid tracking, volume limits, and simulation readiness. Suggest precise improvements before robot execution.

output_examples.input: User asks for a Flex transfer protocol from a source plate to a destination plate.
output: A protocol outline with metadata, requirements, labware, tip racks, and pipette selection.
A transfer sequence with source wells, destination wells, volume, and tip policy.
A reminder to simulate the protocol before running it on the robot.

output_examples.input: User asks to adapt a PCR setup for eight samples.
output: A thermocycler workflow covering lid control, master mix distribution, sample addition, and cycling stages.
Recommended volumes, sample count variables, and liquid labels for run setup visibility.
Checks for tip racks, reaction volume, and final cooling behavior.

output_examples.input: User asks for help finding issues in an Opentrons plan.
output: A review of deck slot conflicts, missing labware, pipette capacity, and module sequencing.
Practical changes to improve contamination control, tip usage, and protocol comments.

best_practices: Simulate every generated protocol before using it on a physical robot.
Confirm labware names, pipette models, deck slots, and module versions against the installed system.
Use clear comments, liquid labels, and conservative tip policies for traceable automated runs.
anti_patterns: Do not run generated protocols without simulation and human review.
Do not assume example volumes fit every labware, pipette, reagent, or assay.
Do not skip contamination checks when changing tip reuse or distribution settings.

faq.question: Does this skill control an Opentrons robot directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides protocol guidance and templates. Users must run protocols through their Opentrons environment.

faq.question: Which robots does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Flex and OT-2 concepts, including pipettes, labware, modules, deck slots, and Protocol API v2 patterns.

faq.question: Can it create PCR setup workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for thermocycler setup, master mix distribution, sample addition, and PCR cycling profiles.

faq.question: Can it validate physical lab safety?
faq.answer: No. It cannot verify calibration, clearance, reagent compatibility, or safety procedures in the physical lab.

faq.question: Should generated protocols be simulated?
faq.answer: Yes. Simulate every protocol and review the run log before using any physical robot.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
